tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example} ↗ ex:n-torus-riemannian-submanifold 1. ch7:7.1

The metric on the $n$-torus induced by the embedding in $\mathbb R^{2n}$ from Example 2.21 is flat: every point has coordinates in which the metric is Euclidean. \end{example}
